data.name: Start_Help
data.value:
ErgoWattControl – control for the Daum ergo_bike 8008 TRS
Usage: ErgoWattControl.exe Normal operation: connects to the cockpit on the configured COM port.
ErgoWattControl.exe -demo [GPX file or recording] Demo mode without a cockpit: a simulated rider (about 75 RPM) replaces the ergometer, the serial port is not used. With a GPX file this route starts at once, without the overview; with a recording (JSON/CSV) or a program, that one is replayed. Example: ErgoWattControl.exe -demo "GPX\Tour.gpx"
ErgoWattControl.exe -main Starts on the main screen instead of the rider's monitor. “Ride view” or key 0 moves the window to the rider's monitor. Can be combined: ErgoWattControl.exe -main -demo
ErgoWattControl.exe -help Shows this help.
Spellings: -demo, --demo, /demo, -main, --main, /main and -help, --help, -h, -?, /? Settings: %AppData%\ErgoWattControl\settings.json, recordings, routes and programs in Documents\ErgoWattControl. If a settings.json lies next to the exe, everything stays in the program folder (portable).
